title: Occupational Therapy Aides
description: Under close supervision of an occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant, perform only delegated, selected, or routine tasks in specific situations. These duties include preparing patient and treatment room.

tasks.text: Encourage patients and attend to their physical needs to facilitate the attainment of therapeutic goals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live emotional encouragement of patients is human presence

dwas.name: Encourage patients during therapeutic activities.

tasks.text: Report to supervisors or therapists, verbally or in writing, on patients' progress, attitudes, attendance, and accomplishments.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft medical reports from structured findings

dwas.name: Prepare medical reports or documents.
Communicate patient status to other health practitioners.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Observe patients' attendance, progress, attitudes, and accomplishments and record and maintain information in client records.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain records; human owns clinical accuracy

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.
Record vital statistics or other health information.
Maintain medical records.

tasks.text: Prepare and maintain work area, materials, and equipment and maintain inventory of treatment and educational supplies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Records trackable; physical verification of medical stock human

dwas.name: Prepare patient treatment areas for use.
Maintain medical equipment or instruments.
Inventory medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Transport patients to and from the occupational therapy work area.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Moving patients requires hands-on body handling

dwas.name: Move patients to or from treatment areas.

tasks.text: Instruct patients and families in work, social, and living skills, the care and use of adaptive equipment, and other skills to facilitate home and work adjustment to disability.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Hands-on adaptive skill teaching with real people

dwas.name: Teach basic living or other adaptive skills to patients or caregivers.
Teach medical procedures or medical equipment use to patients.

tasks.text: Assist occupational therapists in planning, implementing, and administering therapy programs to restore, reinforce, and enhance performance, using selected activities and special equipment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Implementing therapy programs is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Implement therapeutic programs to improve patient functioning.

tasks.text: Demonstrate therapy techniques, such as manual and creative arts and games.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical procedure teaching is hands-on clinical instruction

dwas.name: Teach medical procedures to healthcare personnel.

tasks.text: Manage intradepartmental infection control and equipment security.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI reviews records; human observes physical procedures

dwas.name: Monitor work areas or procedures to ensure compliance with safety procedures.
Manage control system activities in organizations.

tasks.text: Perform clerical, administrative, and secretarial duties, such as answering phones, restocking and ordering supplies, filling out paperwork, and scheduling appointments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical scheduling needs human verification of constraints

dwas.name: Schedule patient procedures or appointments.
Stock medical or patient care supplies.
Perform clerical work in medical settings.

tasks.text: Supervise patients in choosing and completing work assignments or arts and crafts projects.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Engaging patients in exercise is physical, in-person care

dwas.name: Engage patients in exercises or activities.

tasks.text: Adjust and repair assistive devices and make adaptive changes to other equipment and to environments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on medical instrument maintenance

dwas.name: Maintain medical equipment or instruments.

tasks.text: Evaluate the living skills and capacities of clients with physical, developmental, or mental health disabilities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Administering screening tests needs live patient interaction

dwas.name: Administer screening tests to determine abilities or treatment needs.

tasks.text: Accompany patients on outings, providing transportation when necessary.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Hands-on accompaniment and assistance in the world

dwas.name: Accompany patients or clients on outings to provide assistance.

tasks.text: Assist educational specialists or clinical psychologists in administering situational or diagnostic tests to measure client's abilities or progress.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Administering screening tests needs live patient interaction

dwas.name: Administer screening tests to determine abilities or treatment needs.
